G01V.fTerm:
GEOPHYSICS; GRAVITATIONAL MEASUREMENTS; DETECTING MASSES OR OBJECTS; TAGS (means for indicating the location of accidentally buried, e.g. snow-buried, persons A63B 29/02)[4,6]

Note(s)

  • This subclass covers radar, sonar, lidar or analogous systems specifically designed for geophysical use. Radar, sonar, lidar or analogous systems, or details of such systems, if of a general interest, are also classified in subclass G01S.[6]
  • In this subclass, the following term is used with the meaning indicated:
    • "tags" means arrangements cooperating with a detecting field, e.g. near field, and designed to produce a specific detectable effect; "tags" also means active markers capable of generating a detectable field.
  • In this subclass, the geophysical methods apply both to the earth and to other celestial objects, e.g. planets.
  • Attention is drawn to the Notes following the title of class G01.
